duas.title: 1st Kalima (Tayyibah)
duas.arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَّسُولُ اللّٰهِ
duas.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and Muhammad (peace be upon him) is the Messenger of Allah.

duas.title: 2nd Kalima (Shahaadah)
duas.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
duas.translation: I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without any partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.

duas.title: 3rd Kalima (Tamjeed)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَلَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.translation: Glory be to Allah, all praise belongs to Allah, there is no deity except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. There is no power or strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Supreme.

duas.title: 4th Kalima (Tawheed)
duas.arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَّا يَمُوتُ أَبَدًا أَبَدًا، ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.translation: There is no deity except Allah alone, without any partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is Ever-Living and never dies. Possessor of Majesty and Honor; in His hand is all goodness, and He has power over all things.

duas.title: 5th Kalima (Radde Kufr)
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ شَيْئًا وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ بِهِ وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ بِهِ، تُبْتُ عَنْهُ وَتَبَرَّأْتُ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالشِّرْكِ وَالْكِذْبِ وَالْغِيبَةِ وَالْبِدْعَةِ وَالنَّمِيمَةِ وَالْفَوَاحِشِ وَالْبُهْتَانِ وَالْمَعَاصِي كُلِّهَا، وَأَسْلَمْتُ وَأَقُولُ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَّسُولُ اللّٰهِ
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from associating any partner with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do not know. I repent from it and free myself from disbelief, polytheism, falsehood, backbiting, innovation, slander, indecency, false accusation, and all sins. I submit to You and declare: There is no deity except Allah, and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.

duas.title: Imaan-e-Mujmal (Summary of Faith)
duas.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللّٰهِ كَمَا هُوَ بِأَسْمَائِهِ وَصِفَاتِهِ وَقَبِلْتُ جَمِيعَ أَحْكَامِهِ إِقْرَارٌ بِاللِّسَانِ وَتَصْدِيقٌ بِالْقَلْبِ
duas.translation: I believe in Allah as He is with all His Names and Attributes, and I accept all His commands, affirming with the tongue and believing wholeheartedly.

duas.title: Imaan-e-Mufassal (Detailed Faith)
duas.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللّٰهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَالْقَدْرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ تَعَالَىٰ وَالْبَعْثِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ
duas.translation: I believe in Allah, His Angels, His Revealed Books, His Messengers, the Last Day, and in Divine Decree—that all good and bad comes from Allah the Most High—and in resurrection after death.

duas.title: Before Eating
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَعَلَىٰ بَرَكَةِ اللّٰهِ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah and upon the blessings of Allah.

duas.title: Forgetting Dua Before Eating
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah at its beginning and at its end.

duas.title: After Eating
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.translation: All praise belongs to Allah, Who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims.

duas.title: Before Sleeping (1)
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.translation: O Allah, in Your name I die and I live.

duas.title: Upon Awakening
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.translation: All praise belongs to Allah, Who restored us to life after causing us to die, and to Him is the final resurrection.

duas.title: Before Entering the Restroom
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female harmful spirits.

duas.title: After Leaving the Restroom
duas.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنِّي الْأَذَىٰ وَعَافَانِي
duas.translation: I seek Your forgiveness. All praise belongs to Allah, Who removed discomfort from me and granted me relief.

duas.title: When Thanking Someone
duas.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللّٰهُ خَيْرًا
duas.translation: May Allah reward you with goodness.

duas.title: Sneezing Duas
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ — يَرْحَمُكَ اللّٰهُ — يَهْدِيكُمُ اللّٰهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
duas.translation: Sneezer: All praise belongs to Allah. Listener: May Allah have mercy on you. Sneezer's reply: May Allah guide you and improve your condition.

duas.title: For Increase in Knowledge
duas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

duas.title: Before Performing Wudhu
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, and all praise belongs to Allah.

duas.title: Whilst Performing Wudhu
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي وَوَسِّعْ لِي فِي دَارِي وَبَارِكْ لِي فِي رِزْقِي
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive my sins, grant spaciousness in my home, and bless my sustenance.

duas.title: After Completing Wudhu
duas.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، اللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
duas.translation: I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah alone, without partner, and Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah, make me among those who constantly repent and those who purify themselves.

duas.title: When Entering the Masjid
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.translation: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.

duas.title: When Leaving the Masjid
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.translation: O Allah, indeed I ask You of Your bounty.

duas.title: After Drinking Water
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي سَقَانَا عَذْبًا فُرَاتًا بِرَحْمَتِهِ وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْهُ مِلْحًا أُجَاجًا بِذُنُوبِنَا
duas.translation: All praise belongs to Allah, Who gave us fresh, sweet water to drink out of His mercy and did not make it salty and bitter because of our sins.

duas.title: After Drinking Milk
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
duas.translation: O Allah, bless us in it and grant us more of it.

duas.title: When Wearing Clothes
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هٰذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِّنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.translation: All praise belongs to Allah, Who clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any might or power on my part.

duas.title: When Looking into the Mirror
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ أَنْتَ حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
duas.translation: O Allah, just as You have made my outward form beautiful, make my character beautiful as well.

duas.title: When Entering the Home
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ، بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللّٰهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللّٰهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of entering and the goodness of leaving. In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we rely.

duas.title: When Leaving the Home
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللّٰهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah; there is no might and no power except with Allah.

duas.title: When Bidding Farewell
duas.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللّٰهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
duas.translation: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trusts, and the final outcome of your deeds.

duas.title: When It Rains
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
duas.translation: O Allah, make it a beneficial and nourishing rain.

duas.title: Upon Hearing Good News
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
duas.translation: All praise belongs to Allah, by Whose grace good deeds are completed.

duas.title: When a Loss Occurs
duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
duas.translation: Indeed, we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we shall return.

duas.title: When in Bodily Pain
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ (٣) أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ (٧)
duas.translation: Place your hand on the painful area, say Bismillah 3 times, then recite 7 times: I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and fear.

duas.title: When in Difficulty
duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللّٰهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
duas.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the Best Disposer of affairs.

duas.title: Takbeer
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.translation: Allah is the Greatest.

duas.title: Thanaa (Opening Supplication)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللّٰهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَىٰ جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلٰهَ غَيْرُكَ
duas.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, and all praise is Yours. Blessed is Your Name, exalted is Your Majesty, and there is no deity besides You.

duas.title: Ta'awwuz (Seeking Refuge)
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed.

duas.title: Tasmiyah
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

duas.title: Tasbeeh in Ruku
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Supreme.

duas.title: Tasmee' (Rising from Ruku)
duas.arabic: سَمِعَ اللّٰهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ
duas.translation: Allah hears the one who praises Him.

duas.title: Dua in Qaumah (1)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ
duas.translation: Our Lord, to You belongs all praise.

duas.title: Tasbeeh in Sajdah
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَىٰ
duas.translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.

duas.title: Dua in Jalsa (Between Prostrations)
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَعَافِنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, grant me well-being, guide me, and provide for me.

duas.title: Tashahhud (At-Tahiyyaat)
duas.arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلّٰهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَىٰ عِبَادِ اللّٰهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
duas.translation: All verbal, physical, and financial acts of worship belong to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon all righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.

duas.title: Durood-e-Ibraheem
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ، اللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
duas.translation: O Allah, send grace upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, just as You sent grace upon Ibraheem and the family of Ibraheem; indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, just as You blessed Ibraheem and the family of Ibraheem; indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

duas.title: Dua After Durood-e-Ibraheem
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِّنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.translation: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself, and none forgives sins except You. So grant me forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy on me; indeed, You are the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

duas.title: Adhaan (Call to Prayer)
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ (٤) أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ (٢) أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَّسُولُ اللّٰهِ (٢) حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ (٢) حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ (٢) اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ (٢) لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ
duas.translation: Allah is the Greatest (4x). I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah (2x). I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah (2x). Come to prayer (2x). Come to success (2x). Allah is the Greatest (2x). There is no deity except Allah.

duas.title: Iqaamah
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ (٤) أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ (٢) أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَّسُولُ اللّٰهِ (٢) حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ (٢) حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ (٢) قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ (٢) اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ (٢) لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ
duas.translation: Same as Adhaan, with the addition of 'Prayer is indeed established' (twice) before the final Takbeer.

duas.title: Dua After Adhaan
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ هٰذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the station of Waseelah and excellence, and raise him to the praised position that You have promised him; indeed, You never break Your promise.

duas.title: When Getting into a Vehicle
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, all praise belongs to Allah. Glory be to Him Who subjected this transport to us, though we could never have controlled it ourselves, and surely to our Lord we shall return.

duas.title: When the Vehicle or Ship Moves
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ مَجْرِيهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah is its sailing and its anchoring; indeed, my Lord is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

duas.title: When Returning from a Journey
duas.arabic: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
duas.translation: We are returning, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.

duas.title: When Entering a Town or City
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهَا (٣) اللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا جَنَاهَا وَحَبِّبْنَا إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهَا وَحَبِّبْ صَالِحِي أَهْلِهَا إِلَيْنَا
duas.translation: O Allah, bless us in it (3x). O Allah, provide us with its fruits, endear us to its residents, and endear the righteous among its residents to us.

duas.title: Dua-e-Qunoot (Witr)
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعِينُكَ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ وَنَتَوَكَّلُ عَلَيْكَ وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ وَنَشْكُرُكَ وَلَا نَكْفُرُكَ وَنَخْلَعُ وَنَتْرُكُ مَنْ يَّفْجُرُكَ، اللّٰهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَىٰ وَنَحْفِدُ وَنَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ وَنَخْشَىٰ عَذَابَكَ إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالْكُفَّارِ مُلْحِقٌ
duas.translation: O Allah, we seek Your help, Your forgiveness, believe in You, rely upon You, praise You in the best manner, and thank You without being ungrateful. We disassociate from those who disobey You. O Allah, You alone we worship, to You we pray and prostrate, toward You we hasten, hoping for Your mercy and fearing Your punishment; verily Your punishment overtakes the disbelievers.

duas.title: Dua After Witr Salah
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ
duas.translation: Glory be to the Sovereign, the Most Holy. (Recite three times, raising the voice on the third).

duas.title: Upon Seeing the New Crescent Moon
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللّٰهُ
duas.translation: O Allah, let this crescent appear over us with prosperity, faith, safety, and Islam. My Lord and your Lord (O moon) is Allah.

duas.title: Intention Dua for Fasting (Sehri)
duas.arabic: وَبِصَوْمِ غَدٍ نَّوَيْتُ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ
duas.translation: I intend to fast tomorrow for the month of Ramadan.

duas.title: When Breaking the Fast (Iftar)
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَعَلَىٰ رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
duas.translation: O Allah, for You I have fasted, in You I believe, upon You I rely, and with Your provision I break my fast.

duas.title: When Eating as a Guest (1)
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
duas.translation: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided them, forgive them, and have mercy upon them.

duas.title: When Eating the First Fruit of the Season
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مُدِّنَا
duas.translation: O Allah, bless us in our fruits, bless us in our city, and bless us in our weights and measures.

duas.title: When in Financial Difficulty
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful against what You have forbidden, and enrich me by Your grace so I need none besides You.

duas.title: When Seeing Someone in Distress
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا
duas.translation: All praise belongs to Allah, Who spared me from the trial He afflicted you with and favored me greatly over much of His creation. (Recite silently).

duas.title: Dua for Fever
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الْكَبِيرِ أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ الْعَظِيمِ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ عِرْقٍ نَّعَّارٍ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَرِّ النَّارِ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, the Great; I seek refuge in Allah, the Supreme, from the harm of every throbbing vein and from the heat of the Fire.

duas.title: When Visiting the Sick
duas.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ، اللّٰهُمَّ اشْفِهِ اللّٰهُمَّ عَافِهِ
duas.translation: Do not worry; it is a purification from sins, if Allah wills. O Allah, cure him; O Allah, grant him complete health.

duas.title: At the Time of Death
duas.arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَّسُولُ اللّٰهِ، اللّٰهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَىٰ غَمَرَاتِ الْمَوْتِ وَسَكَرَاتِ الْمَوْتِ
duas.translation: There is no deity except Allah, and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, assist me through the pangs and agonies of death.

duas.title: Thanaa in Janazah Salah
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللّٰهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَىٰ جَدُّكَ وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَلَا إِلٰهَ غَيْرُكَ
duas.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, and all praise is Yours. Blessed is Your Name, exalted is Your Majesty, sublime is Your praise, and there is no deity besides You.

duas.title: Janazah Dua for an Adult
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا، اللّٰهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِسْلَامِ وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whomever You keep alive among us, keep him alive upon Islam, and whomever You cause to die, let him die upon true faith.

duas.title: Janazah Dua for a Boy
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطًا وَاجْعَلْهُ لَنَا أَجْرًا وَذُخْرًا وَاجْعَلْهُ لَنَا شَافِعًا وَمُشَفَّعًا
duas.translation: O Allah, make him a forerunner for us, a source of reward and treasure, and an intercessor whose intercession is accepted.

duas.title: Janazah Dua for a Girl
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْهَا لَنَا فَرَطًا وَاجْعَلْهَا لَنَا أَجْرًا وَذُخْرًا وَاجْعَلْهَا لَنَا شَافِعَةً وَمُشَفَّعَةً
duas.translation: O Allah, make her a forerunner for us, a source of reward and treasure, and an intercessor whose intercession is accepted.

duas.title: When Entering the Graveyard
duas.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ، نَسْأَلُ اللّٰهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
duas.translation: Peace be upon you, O dwellers of these abodes among the believers and Muslims. Indeed, if Allah wills, we shall join you. We ask Allah for well-being for us and for you.

duas.title: When Laying the Deceased in the Grave
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَعَلَىٰ مِلَّةِ رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah and upon the way of the Messenger of Allah.

duas.title: When Filling the Grave with Soil
duas.arabic: مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ (١) وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ (٢) وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ (٣)
duas.translation: 1st handful: From earth We created you. 2nd handful: Into it We shall return you. 3rd handful: And from it We shall bring you forth once again.

duas.title: Dua for Parents
duas.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
duas.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them both just as they nurtured me when I was small.

duas.title: At the Time of Sunset
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ هٰذَا إِقْبَالُ لَيْلِكَ وَإِدْبَارُ نَهَارِكَ وَأَصْوَاتُ دُعَاتِكَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي
duas.translation: O Allah, this is the arrival of Your night, the departure of Your day, and the voices of those calling upon You—so forgive me.

duas.title: When Seeing the Moon
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنْ شَرِّ هٰذَا الْغَاسِقِ
duas.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the harm of this darkening night and moon.

duas.title: At the Time of Drought
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ اسْقِنَا اللّٰهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا
duas.translation: O Allah, quench our thirst; O Allah, send us relieving rain.

duas.title: When There Is Excessive Rain
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلَا عَلَيْنَا، اللّٰهُمَّ عَلَى الْآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ وَبُطُونِ الْأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
duas.translation: O Allah, let it fall around us and not upon us. O Allah, direct it to the hills, mountains, valleys, and woodlands.

duas.title: Dua When Leaving a Gathering
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللّٰهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
duas.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, and all praise is Yours. I bear witness that there is no deity except You; I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.

duas.title: When Entering a Market or Shopping Center
duas.arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَّا يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.translation: There is no deity except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs all dominion and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is Ever-Living and never dies. In His hand is all goodness, and He has power over everything.

duas.title: The 99 Beautiful Names of Allah (Asma-ul-Husna)
duas.arabic: هُوَ اللّٰهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الرَّحْمٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلَامُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ الْغَفَّارُ الْقَهَّارُ الْوَهَّابُ الرَّزَّاقُ الْفَتَّاحُ الْعَلِيمُ الْقَابِضُ الْبَاسِطُ الْخَافِضُ الرَّافِعُ الْمُعِزُّ الْمُذِلُّ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ الْحَكَمُ الْعَدْلُ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ الْحَلِيمُ الْعَظِيمُ الْغَفُورُ الشَّكُورُ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ الْحَفِيظُ الْمُقِيتُ الْحَسِيبُ الْجَلِيلُ الْكَرِيمُ الرَّقِيبُ الْمُجِيبُ الْوَاسِعُ الْحَكِيمُ الْوَدُودُ الْمَجِيدُ الْبَاعِثُ الشَّهِيدُ الْحَقُّ الْوَكِيلُ الْقَوِيُّ الْمَتِينُ الْوَلِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ الْمُحْصِي الْمُبْدِئُ الْمُعِيدُ الْمُحْيِي الْمُمِيتُ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ الْوَاجِدُ الْمَاجِدُ الْوَاحِدُ الصَّمَدُ الْقَادِرُ الْمُقْتَدِرُ الْمُقَدِّمُ الْمُؤَخِّرُ الْأَوَّلُ الْآخِرُ الظَّاهِرُ الْبَاطِنُ الْوَالِي الْمُتَعَالِي الْبَرُّ التَّوَّابُ الْمُنْتَقِمُ الْعَفُوُّ الرَّءُوفُ مَالِكُ الْمُلْكِ ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ الْمُقْسِطُ الْجَامِعُ الْغَنِيُّ الْمُغْنِي الْمَانِعُ الضَّارُّ النَّافِعُ النُّورُ الْهَادِي الْبَدِيعُ الْبَاقِي الْوَارِثُ الرَّشِيدُ الصَّبُورُ
duas.translation: He is Allah, besides Whom there is no deity: The Entirely Merciful, The Especially Merciful, The Sovereign, The Pure, The Source of Peace, The Granter of Security, The Guardian, The Almighty, The Compeller, The Supreme, The Creator, The Evolver, The Fashioner, The Perpetual Forgiver, The Subduer, The Bestower, The Provider, The Opener, The All-Knowing, The Withholder, The Extender, The Reducer, The Exalter, The Honorer, The Dishonorer, The All-Hearing, The All-Seeing, The Judge, The Utterly Just, The Subtle, The All-Aware, The Forbearing, The Magnificent, The Forgiving, The Appreciative, The Most High, The Most Great, The Preserver, The Sustainer, The Reckoner, The Majestic, The Generous, The Watchful, The Responsive, The All-Encompassing, The All-Wise, The Most Loving, The Glorious, The Resurrector, The Witness, The Truth, The Trustee, The Strong, The Firm, The Protecting Friend, The Praiseworthy, The Accounter, The Originator, The Restorer, The Giver of Life, The Creator of Death, The Ever-Living, The Sustainer of Existence, The Perceiver, The Illustrious, The One, The Eternal Refuge, The Capable, The Omnipotent, The Expediter, The Delayer, The First, The Last, The Manifest, The Hidden, The Governor, The Most Exalted, The Source of Goodness, The Acceptor of Repentance, The Avenger, The Pardoner, The Most Kind, Master of the Kingdom, Lord of Majesty and Generosity, The Equitable, The Gatherer, The Self-Sufficient, The Enricher, The Preventer, The Distresser, The Propitious, The Light, The Guide, The Incomparable Originator, The Everlasting, The Inheritor, The Guide to the Right Path, The Patient.

duas.title: When Laying the Qurbani Animal Down
duas.arabic: إِنِّي وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذٰلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، اللّٰهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ
duas.translation: Indeed, I have turned my face toward He Who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allah. Indeed, my prayer, my sacrifice, my living, and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, this is from You and for You.

duas.title: When Slaughtering the Animal
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, Allah is the Greatest.

duas.title: Sayyidul Istighfaar (Chief Prayer of Forgiveness)
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I uphold Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favors upon me and confess my sins—so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

duas.title: Istikhara Dua (Seeking Guidance)
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ، اللّٰهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هٰذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هٰذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek Your guidance through Your knowledge, Your ability through Your power, and ask of Your immense bounty; for You have power and I have none, You know and I know not, and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know this matter is good for my faith, livelihood, and outcome, ordain it for me, make it easy, and bless it. And if You know it is harmful for my faith, livelihood, and outcome, turn it away from me and turn me from it, ordain goodness for me wherever it may be, and make me content with it.

duas.title: Most Comprehensive Dua
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ نَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اسْتَعَاذَ مِنْهُ نَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنْتَ الْمُسْتَعَانُ وَعَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ
duas.translation: O Allah, we ask You for all the good that Your Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) asked of You, and we seek refuge in You from all the evil from which Your Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) sought refuge. You are the One sought for help, upon You rests fulfillment, and there is no power or strength except through Allah.

duas.title: At the Time of Anger
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed.

duas.title: When a Dog Barks at Night
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed.

duas.title: When a Donkey Brays
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed.

duas.title: When Welcoming Someone
duas.arabic: أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا وَمَرْحَبًا
duas.translation: You have arrived among family, at ease, and are most welcome.

duas.title: When Intending to Do Something
duas.arabic: إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ
duas.translation: If Allah wills.

duas.title: Morning and Evening Dua
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.translation: O Allah, by Your grace we enter the morning and by Your grace we enter the evening; by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the final resurrection.

duas.title: Before Sleeping (2)
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
duas.translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.

duas.title: When Seeing a Muslim Laugh
duas.arabic: أَضْحَكَ اللّٰهُ سِنَّكَ
duas.translation: May Allah keep you smiling and joyful always.

duas.title: When Eating with Someone Who Is Ill
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ ثِقَةً بِاللّٰهِ وَتَوَكُّلًا عَلَيْهِ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, with full confidence in Allah and reliance upon Him.

duas.title: When Things Are in One's Favor
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
duas.translation: All praise belongs to Allah, by Whose grace all good things are accomplished.

duas.title: When an Evil Thought Comes to Mind
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ، آمَنْتُ بِاللّٰهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
duas.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed; I believe in Allah and His Messengers.

duas.title: When Afflicted with a Calamity
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِّنْهَا
duas.translation: O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it for me with something better.

duas.title: Dua for Steadfastness and Death on Imaan
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
duas.translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself; indeed, You are the Bestower.

duas.title: Dua in Qaumah (2)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُّبَارَكًا فِيهِ
duas.translation: Our Lord, to You belongs all praise—abundant, pure, and full of blessings.

duas.title: When the Sun Rises
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي أَقَالَنَا يَوْمَنَا هٰذَا وَلَمْ يُهْلِكْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا
duas.translation: All praise belongs to Allah, Who granted us this new day and did not destroy us because of our sins.

duas.title: Dua After Breaking the Fast (Iftar)
duas.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ
duas.translation: Thirst has vanished, the veins are moistened, and the reward is assured, if Allah wills.

duas.title: When Wearing New Clothes
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي مَا أُوَارِي بِهِ عَوْرَتِي وَأَتَجَمَّلُ بِهِ فِي حَيَاتِي
duas.translation: All praise belongs to Allah, Who clothed me with that which covers my nakedness and adorns me in my life.

duas.title: When Eating as a Guest (2)
duas.arabic: أَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَأَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ
duas.translation: May the righteous partake of your food, may the angels pray for blessings upon you, and may those who fast break their fast with you.

duas.title: When Beginning a Journey
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣) سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ، اللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هٰذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ، اللّٰهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هٰذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللّٰهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
duas.translation: Allah is the Greatest (3x). Glory be to Him Who subjected this to us, and surely to our Lord we shall return. O Allah, we ask You in this journey for righteousness, piety, and deeds pleasing to You. Ease this journey for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are our Companion on the journey and Guardian over our family. I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, distressing sights, and an evil return regarding wealth and family.

duas.title: For Protection of Faith, Life, Family & Wealth
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ عَلَىٰ دِينِي وَنَفْسِي وَوَلَدِي وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
duas.translation: In the name of Allah upon my religion, my life, my children, my family, and my wealth. (Recite 3 times morning and evening).

duas.title: For Protection Against Sudden Harm
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, with Whose Name nothing in the earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. (Recite 3 times morning and evening).

duas.title: For Pleasure of Allah on the Day of Judgment
duas.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللّٰهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
duas.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (peace be upon him) as my Prophet. (Recite 3 times after Fajr and Maghrib).

duas.title: For Relief from Worries and Debts
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, from weakness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from being overwhelmed by debt and overpowered by people.

duas.title: Before Sleeping (3)
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.translation: In Your name, my Lord, I lay my side down, and by You I raise it. If You take my soul, have mercy on it; and if You release it, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.

duas.title: At the Time of Thunder
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَقْتُلْنَا بِغَضَبِكَ وَلَا تُهْلِكْنَا بِعَذَابِكَ وَعَافِنَا قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ
duas.translation: O Allah, do not slay us with Your wrath, do not destroy us with Your punishment, and grant us safety before that.

duas.title: When Experiencing Something Unfavorable
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ حَالٍ
duas.translation: All praise belongs to Allah in every circumstance.

duas.title: When a Fire Breaks Out
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest.

duas.title: Comprehensive Protection Dua of Abu Darda (RA)
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَأَنْتَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، مَا شَاءَ اللّٰهُ كَانَ وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ اللّٰهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا، اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
duas.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no deity except You. Upon You I rely, and You are Lord of the Mighty Throne. Whatever Allah wills occurs, and whatever He does not will never occurs. There is no power or strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Supreme. I know that Allah has power over all things and encompasses everything in knowledge. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own soul and from the evil of every creature You hold by its forelock; indeed, my Lord is on a straight path.

duas.title: After Slaughtering the Qurbani Animal
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْهُ مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَ مِنْ حَبِيبِكَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَخَلِيلِكَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِمَا الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ
duas.translation: O Allah, accept this sacrifice from me just as You accepted from Your beloved Muhammad and Your close friend Ibraheem (peace be upon them both).

duas.title: Dua Upon Completing the Holy Qur'an
duas.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ آنِسْ وَحْشَتِي فِي قَبْرِي، اللّٰهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي بِالْقُرْآنِ الْعَظِيمِ وَاجْعَلْهُ لِي إِمَامًا وَنُورًا وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً، اللّٰهُمَّ ذَكِّرْنِي مِنْهُ مَا نَسِيتُ وَعَلِّمْنِي مِنْهُ مَا جَهِلْتُ وَارْزُقْنِي تِلَاوَتَهُ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَأَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ وَاجْعَلْهُ لِي حُجَّةً يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, comfort my loneliness in the grave. Have mercy on me through the Magnificent Qur'an and make it for me a leader, light, guidance, and mercy. Remind me of what I have forgotten from it, teach me what I am ignorant of, grant me its recitation during the hours of the night and ends of the day, and make it a proof in my favor, O Lord of the worlds.
